name: init7-tv-webos
description: Unofficial LG webOS TV app for Init7 TV7: all channels incl. multicast, fast switching, programme guide

scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && ares-package build/app build/service -o dist
scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs --dev && ares-package build/app build/service -o dist && node scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
